
### Relative Expression of domains found in known toxins

```{r, results='asis',fig.align='center'}

# Read images
image1 <- rasterGrob(readPNG(IP_1), interpolate = TRUE)
image2 <- rasterGrob(readPNG(IP_1_Legend), interpolate = TRUE)

image1
image2

cat(" \n\n Figure 1. Relative expression of transcripts based on interproscan domains found in known toxins.\n\n ") 

```

```{r, results='asis',fig.align='center'}

# Read images
image1 <- rasterGrob(readPNG(MF_1), interpolate = TRUE)
image2 <- rasterGrob(readPNG(MF_1_Legend), interpolate = TRUE)
image1
image2
cat(" \n\n Figure 2. Relative expression of transcripts based on Molecular Functions found in known toxins.  \n\n ") 

```

```{r, results='asis',fig.align='center'}

# Read images
image1 <- rasterGrob(readPNG(BP_1), interpolate = TRUE)
image2 <- rasterGrob(readPNG(BP_1_Legend), interpolate = TRUE)

image1
image2
cat(" \n\n Figure 3. Relative expression of transcripts based on Biological Processess found in known toxins.  \n\n ") 

```
